West Bengal CM attributes TMC crisis to 'arrogance' and 'Lord Ram's curse'

West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari has stated that the current crisis within the Trinamool Congress (TMC) is a consequence of the party's 'arrogance' and what he described as 'Lord Ram's curse'. The Chief Minister made these remarks in relation to the ongoing political situation involving the TMC. The coverage does not provide further details on the specific nature of the crisis or the context of the curse.
